description: This file defines an interface 'StreamFactoryInterface' within the 'Psr\Http\Message' namespace. It specifies methods for creating stream objects from strings, files, and resources, adhering to the PSR-17 HTTP Factories standard.

classes.name: StreamFactoryInterface
classes.description: Interface specifying methods for creating stream objects from various sources, such as strings, files, and resources.

methods.name: createStream
methods.description: Creates a new stream from a string content, using a temporary resource.

methods.name: createStreamFromFile
methods.description: Creates a stream from an existing file, opening it with the specified mode.

methods.name: createStreamFromResource
methods.description: Creates a stream from an existing resource, which must be readable.
